name: Kali
source:
Drifting through life from one rave to another and scamming people for a living, Kali was a [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Ravnos]Ravnos[/url] through and through long before catching the eye of Reynard Cassel. Seeing her as a potential asset, he promptly [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embraced[/url] her almost two years ago.

Her unique insight into human nature and access to secure dark web trading channels have been a great boon to her coterie. As the logistics expert, she ensures the merchandise - no matter how shady - ends up in the right hands.

However, with her [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Sire]sire's[/url] mysterious disappearance, Kali must learn how to swim in uncharted waters instead of simply relying on her gifts and Lady Luck's smile.

[From the in-game profile]
